There are 4 upgraded tiers of Crimson Armor: '''Hot''', '''Burning''', '''Fiery''', and '''Infernal''', which can all be obtained by prestiging the previous tier. == Obtaining == Basic Tier '''Crimson Armor''' Pieces can be obtained from [[Kuudra#Reward Chests|Paid Reward Chests]] at the end of a [[Kuudra]] fight. ;Piece Drop Chances *Basic Tier: {{Green|4.31%}} *Hot Tier: {{Green|4.2%}} *Burning Tier: {{Green|4.05%}} *Fiery Tier: {{Green|3.91%}} *Infernal Tier: {{Green|4.08%}} Higher tiers of '''Crimson Armor''' can be obtained by prestiging the previous tier at a blacksmith ({{NPCSprite|Malik}}, {{NPCSprite|Igor}}, {{NPCSprite|Alwin}}, or [[The Hex]]), which can be done if it has 10 [[Star Upgrades|Stars]] applied to it. Lose 1 stack after {{Abbr|{{Red|4s}}|2 Pieces}}➜{{Abbr|{{Red|7s}}|3 Pieces}}➜{{Abbr|{{Red|10s}}|4 Pieces}} of not gaining a stack. |tiered_bonus_required_pieces = 2+ }} Upon having at least 2 pieces equipped, the {{AN|Tiered Set Bonus: Dominus}} is unlocked. When hitting enemies with melee attacks, 1 stack is gained, with a cooldown dependent on how many pieces of '''Crimson Armor''' are being worn - 1.5s for wearing two pieces, 1s for wearing three, and 0.5s if wearing all four pieces. Each stack increases some of the player's stats by a certain amount, up to ten stacks: *Basic Tier: {{Stat|swing range|0.05}} *Hot Tier: {{Stat|swing range|0.1}} *Burning Tier: {{Stat|swing range|0.1}} and {{Stat|fero|1}} *Fiery Tier: {{Stat|swing range|0.1}} and {{Stat|fero|2}} *Infernal Tier: {{Stat|swing range|0.1}}, {{Stat|fero|2}}, and {{Stat|damage|+10%}} Upon reaching 10 stacks of Dominus, the player performs a Swipe attack. The swipe's damage is usually 15-25% of their last melee hit. It will do double damage to the first enemy it hits and can trigger multiple times on the same enemy. Its damage is affected by the tier of armor and how many pieces are worn: {| class="wikitable" !Tier !2/4 Multiplier !3/4 Multiplier !4/4 Multiplier |- !Basic |0.5 |1.0 |1.5 |- !Hot |0.625 |1.25 |1.875 |- !Burning |0.75 |1.5 |2.25 |- !Fiery |0.875 |1.75 |2.625 |- !Infernal |1.0 |2.0 |3.0 |- |} The swipe's damage is affected by [[Damage Calculation#Additive Sources|Additive Damage Sources]], with higher % bonus decreasing the swipe's damage. == Essence Crafting == |-|Basic = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |30 |35 |40 |45 |50 |55 |60 |70; 2 Heavy Pearl |80; 3 Heavy Pearl |90; 4 Heavy Pearl |prestige = 150; 10 Kuudra Teeth; 2000000 Coins }} |-|Hot = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |170 |190 |215 |240 |270 |300 |340 |390; 3 Heavy Pearl |440; 4 Heavy Pearl |500; 5 Heavy Pearl |prestige = 800; 20 Kuudra Teeth; 5000000 Coins }} |-|Burning = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |900 |1000 |1125 |1270 |1450 |1650 |1850 |2100; 3 Heavy Pearl |2350; 4 Heavy Pearl |2650; 5 Heavy Pearl |prestige = 4500; 50 Kuudra Teeth; 10000000 Coins }} |-|Fiery = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |5000 |5600 |6300 |7000 |8000 |9000 |10200 |11500; 3 Heavy Pearl |13000; 4 Heavy Pearl |14500; 5 Heavy Pearl |prestige = 25500; 80 Kuudra Teeth; 20000000 Coins }} |-|Infernal = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |30000 |35000 |41000 |48000 |56000 |65500 |76000 |89000; 3 Heavy Pearl |105000; 4 Heavy Pearl |120000; 5 Heavy Pearl |140000; 6 Heavy Pearl; 20 Kuudra Teeth |165000; 7 Heavy Pearl; 40 Kuudra Teeth |192000; 8 Heavy Pearl; 60 Kuudra Teeth |225000; 9 Heavy Pearl; 80 Kuudra Teeth |265000; 10 Heavy Pearl; 100 Kuudra Teeth }} == Skins == {{Item Skins|Crimson Helmet}} == Trivia == * Upon release, the tiered bonus {{AN|Dominus}} ignored hit delay cooldown upon reaching 10 stacks. This allowed people with a decent CPS to accomplish ridiculously fast bosses and achieve an insane amount of DPS. * Currently, this armor set is the best out-of-dungeons generalist melee armor set in the game at its '''Infernal Tier''' with 15 [[Stars]], which requires you to upgrade each set piece 4 times, resulting in the adding of 220 [[Stars]] in total to the set. The admins have made clear that there is intention to eventually release an armor set stronger than Crimson, though it'd come with it's own combat content accordingly.https://discord.com/channels/489529070913060867/1510991226487177216/1513580796013838406 * Before the release of the revamped {{AN|Dominus}}, swipes could also trigger on arrow hits. * Upon release, {{AN|Dominus}} could activate on magic hits, making it one of the best mage armor sets in the game outside dungeons. * '''Crimson Armor''' was the second item, and currently only armor, to
